name: Save New X Search Results to Airtable

parameters.jsCode:
function plan({posts,includes,pageState}){const records=pageState?.records;if(!Array.isArray(posts)||!Array.isArray(records))throw Error('Invalid search or Airtable response');const users=new Map((includes?.users??[]).map(u=>[String(u.id),u.username])),known=new Set(records.map(r=>r?.fields?.Tweet_id).filter(x=>x!==undefined&&x!==null).map(String)),pending=[];for(const p of posts){if(typeof p.id!=='string'||typeof p.text!=='string'||typeof p.createdAt!=='string'||typeof p.publicMetrics?.like_count!=='number')throw Error('Missing post ID, text, creation time or like count');if(known.has(p.id))continue;const author=users.get(String(p.authorId));if(typeof author!=='string'||!author)throw Error('Missing expanded post author');const replyId=p.raw?.in_reply_to_user_id,reply=replyId==null?null:users.get(String(replyId));if(replyId!=null&&typeof reply!=='string')throw Error('Missing expanded reply user');pending.push({fields:{Likes:p.publicMetrics?.like_count??0,Tweet:p.text,Tweet_id:p.id,'Tweet URL':'https://twitter.com/'+author+'/status/'+p.id,Author:reply,Time:p.createdAt}})}return{pending}}

const search=$('Search recent X posts').first().json;const posts=(search.data??[]).map(p=>({id:p.id,text:p.text,authorId:p.author_id,createdAt:p.created_at,publicMetrics:p.public_metrics,raw:p})),records=$input.all().map(x=>x.json).filter(x=>x&&x.fields);const p=plan({posts,includes:search.includes??{},pageState:{records}});return p.pending.map(x=>({json:x.fields,pairedItem:{item:0}}));
